title: Contribution Analysis: course, bibliography, templates and red team protocol
description: A working library for Contribution Analysis, a theory-based approach to impact evaluation. It holds an eight-lesson interactive course with reference cards and applied questions; an annotated bibliography of sources each verified at source, with BibTeX and an errata page; five design templates; and a red team protocol for checking that a Contribution Analysis was done properly. Every statement about what an author says carries a page number.
